action_inputs.description: JSON object of Terraform variable name/value pairs to apply. Pre-filled with this deployment's current variable values; edit any you want to change. Only variables this deployment already manages may be set here (unknown keys are rejected before anything is written); removing a key leaves that variable unchanged. Do not paste secrets into this plaintext field.
action_inputs.label: Parameters (JSON)
action_inputs.name: parameters

description: Updates an HCP Terraform VM deployment's variables from a JSON object and runs with a plan-approval pause.
name: Terraform Update
